FriendGames
Version 1.0.0

Play party games with your friends on one phone. Discover games, save your favorites and take turns sharing the phone.

This version is in development. VIP is a demo with no real subscriptions or payments.
Gizemli olayın ardındaki gerçeği yalnızc: Solve the truth behind a mysterious event together using only yes/no questions. One moderator, many detectives!
Bir yönetici seçin. Yönetici önce hikâye: Choose a moderator. The moderator first reads the opening and secret solution alone.
Yönetici çözümü gizlesin ve yalnızca hik: The moderator hides the solution and shares only the story opening with the group.
Oyuncular evet veya hayır ile yanıtlanab: Players ask yes/no questions. The moderator answers “Yes”, “No”, or optionally “Irrelevant”.
Fikir alışverişi serbesttir. Rastgele ta: Discuss ideas freely. Use logical deductions from the answers instead of random guesses.
Yönetici çözümü değiştirmesin, tutarlı c: The moderator must keep the solution unchanged, answer consistently, and avoid direct hints or leading players.
Grup olayın nedenini, gelişimini ve sonu: When the group identifies the cause, sequence and outcome, the moderator confirms and reveals the full solution. You win together!
